records.plant_name: Aligned Frederick Data Center power station

verifications.note: Names the permittee Aligned Data Centers (MD) Propco, LLC and the address 5601 Manor Woods Road, Frederick, Maryland 21703.

records.researcher_notes: GEM does not list this data center. The Maryland Department of the Environment issued an air permit to construct, effective January 30, 2025, to Aligned Data Centers (MD) Propco, LLC for the data center at 5601 Manor Woods Road, Frederick, on the former Eastalco aluminum site that is now the Quantum campus. The permit covers 168 diesel emergency generators of 3,000 kilowatts each and 4 of 1,000 kilowatts each, 508 MW in all. That is far above the 50 MW threshold, so the plant is an add. The state Public Service Commission denied a first exemption request in August 2023 and Aligned withdrew it in October 2023. A 2024 state law then exempted backup generators and Aligned went ahead. A Frederick News-Post report of February 15, 2025 says Aligned held a ceremonial groundbreaking in December and a Data Center Dynamics report of February 5, 2025 says it has broken ground on the first building. The point shown is a street address match, so the location accuracy is approximate. The owner company has no entry in the entity system, so a new entity is needed. The state notice, Aligned's own application and the 2023 state Public Service Commission order all confirm the engine sizes as electrical ratings. The Commission order of October 10, 2023 shows Aligned first filed its exemption request on May 12, 2023 for 168 generators of 3 MW, so the project was first on public record in May 2023. That filing was dropped in October 2023 and the project restarted in 2024, so the milestone dates run from the July 2024 application. The state's 508 MW total is 504 MW from the large generators and 4 MW from the house generators. A groundbreaking was reported for the first building, but it was a ceremony and no report was found of physical work on the Building 1 generators or building, so all four buildings are pre-construction. The Aligned application is the source for the four-building split.
records.action: Create the Aligned Frederick plant in Frederick County, Maryland, with the four unit rows below. Rows 1 and 2 are the generators of Building 1, pre-construction, 127 MW. Rows 3 and 4 are the generators of Buildings 2 to 4, pre-construction, 381 MW. The rows add up to 508 MW, which matches the state permit's 168 generators of 3,000 kW and 4 of 1,000 kW. The owner needs a new entity.

records.plant_name: Amazon Frederick Data Center power station

verifications.note: Names Amazon Data Services, Inc. and 3250 Digital Drive, Frederick, Maryland 21703.
Reports the Rowan Bauxite site plan at the Quantum Loophole site with 92 backup generators of 2.75 MW.
Reports Amazon as the tenant of the Bauxite I campus, four buildings, on the former Alcoa site.

records.researcher_notes: GEM does not list this data center. The Maryland Department of the Environment approved an air permit to construct on March 25, 2026 for Amazon Data Services at 3250 Digital Drive, Frederick. It covers 92 Caterpillar 3516E diesel generators of 2,750 kilowatts, 6 of 750 kilowatts and 1 of 250 kilowatts, 257.75 MW in all. That is far above the 50 MW threshold, so the plant is an add. The four buildings are BWI-150 to BWI-153. Press reports say Amazon is the tenant of Rowan Digital Infrastructure's Bauxite I campus on the Quantum site, and a trade report on the Rowan plan counts 92 generators of 2.75 MW, which matches this permit. So the Rowan site and this permit are the same campus. County documents and Rowan give 253 MW and 231 MW. The permit sum is used here. Amazon has filed a second application for a separate campus, which has its own record. I found no exact point for 3250 Digital Drive, so the point shown is the Quantum campus area and the accuracy is approximate. The permit was approved in March 2026. Amazon applied on October 29, 2024, and the permit gives a start to expected operation window of 2025 to 2026. I found no report from Amazon, Rowan, the county or the press that work has started, so the status is pre-construction.

records.plant_name: Amazon Frederick IAD-534 Data Center power station

verifications.note: Names Amazon Data Services, Inc. as applicant for IAD-534 to IAD-537 in Frederick County and says the facility is a separate source from the BWI-150 campus.

records.researcher_notes: GEM does not list this data center. Amazon Data Services applied to the Maryland Department of the Environment for an air permit to construct for four data centers called IAD-534 to IAD-537 in Frederick County. The state's March 25, 2026 release says Amazon has applied for an additional Frederick facility, and a public meeting on the IAD-534 campus was held on May 28, 2026. The application and the state's slides list 99 diesel emergency generators, 92 of 2,750 kilowatts, 6 of 750 kilowatts and 1 of 250 kilowatts, 257.75 MW in all. That is far above the 50 MW threshold, so the plant is an add. The application says it is a separate source from Amazon's BWI-150 campus, which is the 3250 Digital Drive plant in the other new record, and the slides place it 0.59 miles away. The state notice names the site as 3300 Radiant Way. A tracker site links that address to Rowan's Bauxite II, but I did not find that in a state document. No permit has been issued, but the application is filed and under review, so the status is pre-construction. The state notice says it received the application on February 23, 2026. I found no exact point, so the point shown is the Quantum campus area and the accuracy is approximate. I found no Public Service Commission exemption case for it.
